systems.system: GUCE CI (Guichet Unique du Commerce Extérieur)

note: Announces a forum; says GUCE CI aims to strengthen interconnection with Customs but does not state a single window in service joining customs, nor customs declaration processing.
Data-sharing protocol between GUCE-CI and the domestic tax directorate; no customs system status and no exchange with another country's customs.
The document states nothing on this study's questions for CIV.

facts.fact: Ivorian customs says SYDAM World moved in 2014 to version 2, based on ASYCUDA World, with electronic payment, data exchange and interoperability services.

GUCE CI's terms of use say its e-DAU module lets customs agents enter and submit detailed customs declarations through the GUCE platform, partially used since 2016 because operators may also lodge declarations directly with SYDAM.

GUCE CI's terms of use describe GUCE as a transactional single-window web portal where operators meet import, export and transit formalities, with customs clearance modules (e-DAU, e-Risk) alongside technical-ministry pre-clearance modules.

systems.tiers: pre-clearance, customs clearance, logistics, finance modules

facts.fact: Ivorian customs says the first pilot phase of the customs interconnection with Ghana, funded by the World Bank, was launched in Accra on 28 July 2017, with a data-exchange demonstration and a single declaration crossing the border at the pilot site.

note: A customs value database is described; electronic clearance is not stated.

facts.fact: Ivorian customs describes its Douane Intelligente modernisation project, backed by Huawei, as being deployed, with a 5-14 December 2025 training mission to China.

The ECOWAS Commission says SIGMAT, its interconnected transit-goods system for electronic data exchange between Member States, has been in use by implementing states since 2019, and that a 21-25 July 2025 mission to Ghana resolved the technical and functional challenges hindering transit between Cote d'Ivoire and Ghana.

The Ministry of Commerce says the GUCE-CI single window lets traders complete import, export and transit formalities entirely online and is the central digital interface between operators, public administrations and banks, with ten years of service.

systems.country_label: Guichet Unique du Commerce Extérieur de Côte d'Ivoire

facts.fact: GUCE CI's director says traders have for several years submitted customs declarations and paid duties and taxes electronically through the GUCE transaction portal.
GUCE CI, the foreign-trade single window implemented in 2013, lets traders file customs formalities, licences and declarations electronically for the administrations involved.

Douanes Ivoiriennes report that Cote d Ivoire and Mali teams met on 24-25 September 2026 to assess SIGMAT in its operating phase on the Abidjan-Bamako transit corridor, sharing information between the two administrations.

systems.country_label: Systeme Interconnecte de Gestion des Marchandises en Transit

facts.fact: ECOWAS says Cote d'Ivoire was connected to the SIGMAT goods-in-transit data exchange system for its customs administration in July 2024.

note: Cote d'Ivoire is named only as a future partner country; no customs system fact.

facts.fact: Gambian MP Maimuna Cessay said SIGMAT implementation, limited to a number of countries, includes Cote d'Ivoire.

note: Database record only; both claims are held.

facts.fact: 225.ci reports the foreign trade single window application Guce mobile was launched on 25 July 2024, a platform for traders, customs brokers, technical ministries and banks.
225.ci says the Guce platform includes pre-clearance and customs clearance modules used by customs brokers and importers and exporters.

AIP reports that on 19 November 2026 the trade ministry launched online issuance of prior export authorisations for food crops on the GUCE CI foreign-trade single window, processed by the OCPV and the Directorate of Trade Regulation.
